title: Weekly digest with phone styles
brief:
A weekly digest, Orbit Weekly.

- Preview text: "Three things shipped this week."
- Orbit logo at the top: https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-logo.png (a 252×128 file, shown 126px wide).
- Under the logo, a menu of three links: "Product" to https://orbit.dev/product, "Blog" to https://orbit.dev/blog, "Pricing" to https://orbit.dev/pricing.
- Heading: "Three things shipped this week", 32px on desktop and 24px on phones.
- Paragraphs, one per item:
  - "Dark mode for every template."
  - "Faster renders, about twice as fast."
  - "A new keyboard shortcut panel."
- A tip shown on desktop only, hidden on phones: "Reading on a desktop? Press ? anywhere in Orbit to see every shortcut."
- Footer: social links to X (https://x.com/orbit) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/orbit), then "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco".
- White background, 600px content.
